links.comparator_used: ChatGPT-attributed diagnostic feedback shown without the warning ('ChatGPT can make mistakes. Check important info')
links.outcome: Diagnosis change rate after viewing disagreeing ChatGPT advice (advice-taking) among medical students
links.quote: The warning did not influence diagnostic changes (15.3% no-warning vs. 15.9% warning; OR = 1.09, 95% CI: 0.46-2.59, p = 0.84).
